title_sq: MYSLYM SHYRI, SHESIM NJESI SHERBIMI PER ZYRA OSE KLINIKE
description_sq:
Në një nga zonat më të kërkuara të kryeqytetit, ofrohet për shitje njesi sherbimi per zyra ose klinike.
Njesia ndodhet ne katin e pare, me nje siperfaqe totale 305.25m2 dhe 256.78me neto, e cila eshte open space.
Ndertesa eshte e pajisur me 2 ashensore dhe ofron mundesi blerje parkimi me cmim ekstra.
Projekti eshte aktuaisht ne faze ndertimi dhe perfundon per 2 vite.
Mundesi blerje me keste. 
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni.
title_en: MYSLYM SHYRI, SELL SERVICE UNITS FOR OFFICES OR CLINICS
description_en: In one of the most sought-after areas of the capital, a service unit for offices or clinics is offered for sale. The unit is located on the first floor, with a total area of ​​305.25m2 and 256.78m net, which is open space. The building is equipped with 2 elevators and offers the possibility of purchasing parking at an extra cost. The project is currently in the construction phase and will be completed in 2 years. Cash purchase option. For more information, contact us.
